issues.detail: The skill does not handle missing or invalid input fields, nor does it describe error handling or edge cases.
The skill assumes a Node.js environment with specific versions and the three library, limiting portability to other platforms.

scenarios.name: generate-building3d-json
scenarios.rationale: Response A provides more structure and numeric values, but still fails to meet the rubric; Response B is incomplete and thus even less compliant.

scenarios.name: render-threejs-massing
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response A does not implement buildModel/toThree and uses requestAnimationFrame instead of setAnimationLoop.

scenarios.name: export-glb-and-pascal-editor
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers the GLTFExporter export and Pascal Editor setup more fully, while Response A misses the required exporter and Pascal steps entirely.
